        <image width="1200" height="1500" transform="translate(209.35 431.68) scale(.2)" href="assets/portrait/DSC02321.png" role="img" aria-label="Marco Pröfrock" />
      </g>
      <g>
        <text class="cls-6" transform="translate(465.2 400.09)"><tspan x="0" y="0">two clients</tspan></text>
        <text class="cls-8" transform="translate(465.72 441.66)"><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="0">marco's approach is multidisciplinary: industrial </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="24">design, graphic design, communication design. </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="48">he treats object, system and message as different </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="72">tools to make an idea come to life.</tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="120">his conviction – a brief has two clients: </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="144">the company that pays and the people it reaches. </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="168">both should walk away with something. that only </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="192">works when what a project gives to the public and </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="216">its commercial interests are married in the same idea.</tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="264">he is working inside of commercial briefs rather </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9" x="0" y="288">than outside of them.</tspan><tspan x="177.14" y="288" xml:space="preserve"> a media budget is the widest </tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="312">distribution channel a young designer will ever be </tspan></tspan><tspan class="cls-9"><tspan x="0" y="336">handed, and he would rather aim it than refuse it.</tspan></tspan></text>
      </g>
      <text class="cls-8" transform="translate(27.96 148.66)"><tspan x="0" y="0">hi i am marco, welcome to my website.</tspan></text>
      </g>
  </g>
</svg>
